title: What's going on

open.say: Say what's happening in your own words, or pick the closest.

lines.means: Pages take ages to come up or the job times out.
Wrong output, a crash, or behaviour that doesn't match what I expected.

lines.line: I can't get it running at all
lines.means: Installing, configuring or starting it up the first time.

lines.line: I can't tell how it's meant to work
lines.means: The explanation is missing or the naming is confusing.

lines.line: The numbers it shows me are wrong
lines.means: The contents are wrong, missing or stale, not the program misbehaving.

lines.line: It costs more than it should
lines.means: Money, billing, quota or usage limits.
Logging in, permissions, keys, being locked out.

lines.line: It just doesn't do the thing I need
lines.means: Something it doesn't do at all yet.

open.aside: Eight kinds of problem, and people usually describe the symptom rather than the category.
